assets.label: Idle
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Make one finished transparent full-body pose for the exact Patroclus in the two reference images. Image 1 is his approved face and paint-style reference. Image 2 is his approved full-body costume and proportion reference.
Preserve his adult age around thirty, softly square face, warm olive skin, chestnut curls, warm brown eyes, light stubble, kind expression, lean athletic build, and natural proportions. Preserve his teal knee-length linen chiton with cream leaf-patterned hem and neck trim, saffron-gold wool cloak, round bronze cloak pin, coral woven belt with hanging ends, brown leather sandals, and short sheathed sword at his hip. Keep the approved warm painterly finish, rich woven texture, fine face detail, and soft natural light.
This pose has empty hands. His sword stays sheathed as a worn costume detail. Paint the character alone.
Full-body portrait canvas, exactly 1024 by 1536 pixels. Keep the complete head, both hands, clothing, both legs and both sandalled feet inside the image. Use generous clear margins of about 60 pixels around all extremities. For standing poses, keep natural scale with head near y90 and soles near y1440. For seated sleep, preserve that same head and body scale while placing the compact pose in the lower part of the canvas.
The native direction is a three-quarter turn toward SCREEN LEFT. Keep the face readable and the complete silhouette clear for a small game stage.
Background: genuine RGBA transparency throughout every area outside the character and inside gaps between limbs and cloth. All lighting and shading stay inside the body and costume. Transparent empty space surrounds the figure. Deliver one isolated finished PNG pose.

POSE: IDLE. A relaxed standing pose for his everyday presence. His weight rests naturally on one leg. Both empty hands rest loosely at his sides, fingers relaxed and visible. He looks slightly toward screen left with his approved affectionate warm smile. His gold cloak hangs naturally and his shoulders are at ease. He feels approachable, patient, and loyal.
